what: Grab a photo note and it lifts to 1.06x, the shadow deepens from the skin’s --kf-shadow-soft to --kf-shadow-lift (.2s), and it follows the hand as is. On release it bounces slightly with back.out(2) and pins back in (.3s). With data-fx-cursor-ball present, the label reads ”Pin” while held and ”Unpin” on release, matching the cursor-ball verbs.

options.verb-drag: Verb for cursor-ball while grabbed, default stick
options.tilt: When grabbed, tilts randomly within ± this angle (deg) and returns to 0° on release, default 0 (no tilt)

from.where: index.html desktop icon drag (index.js Draggable onPress·onRelease) — scale: 1.03; up: .15; down: .35; down-ease: back.out(3)

index.html .cta__s (contact band sticker drag, within the original Draggable bounds) — scale: 1.2; up: .1; down: .2; down-ease: back.out(3); tilt: 30 · detail.html .dgal__card (photo board card) — scale: 1.1; up: .1; down: .2; down-ease: back.out(3)

note: No dragging on phones (no hover) — so pushing on it still lets the page scroll down
